title: Unified Intake Flow for Commitment Adjustments, Invoice Tagging, and Marketplace Offset Requests
creator: Aria Chen
description:
Problem: Sales, RevOps, and Customer Success regularly submit ad-hoc requests that touch commitments, invoice tagging, and marketplace credit offsets. Today these requests flow through multiple spreadsheets + email threads leading to inconsistent decisions, slow SLAs, and mismatched invoice line items. Examples: partial commitment conversions, legacy credit mapping for marketplace refunds, and manual invoice tag corrections after billing runs.

Goal: Define a single intake form and prioritization rubric + an operator decision flow that maps an incoming ask to (a) commit change, (b) invoice adjustment, (c) marketplace offset, or (d) deny/alternate. Enable automated response templates for common outcomes and surface required artifacts to speed decisions (contract excerpts, usage deltas, revenue impact estimate).

Out of scope: core billing engine changes, full invoice automation (we will produce tagging and handoffs), and legal contract renegotiation process (we will attach contract references and escalate).
acceptance_criteria: Create a standardized intake form hosted in Confluence and webhooked to Linear with structured fields for request type, customer, contract ID, requested outcome, reason, fiscal owner, and attachments.
Publish a four-tier prioritization rubric (Emergency / High / Medium / Low) that maps to SLA targets: 24h, 3d, 10d, 30d respectively.

Decision flowchart that results in one of: Commitment Adjustment, Invoice Tag Correction (manual), Marketplace Offset (credit), or Escalate to Legal/Sales. Flowchart must include data required to approve each outcome.
Triaging queue implemented in Console as a dashboard widget for RevOps showing incoming requests, status, and suggested owner; dashboard must link to the intake artifacts and revenue impact estimate.
Create three response templates for common decisions (approve commitment change, issue marketplace credit, deny with alternatives) and a library of example contract clauses to reference.
Pilot with two enterprise customers (one Marketplace merchant, one committed-customer) and close 3 pilot requests end-to-end before due_date.
Instrument metrics: time-to-decision (median), %requests resolved without legal escalation, and accuracy of invoice tag fixes (post-fix audit within 30d).

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Manual invoice edits introduce human error and audit failures. Mitigation: require two-person review for invoices > $2k and log immutable audit note.
Risk: Marketplace merchants may have complex refund flows not covered by simple offsets. Mitigation: create a marketplace-specific runbook and escalate to Marketplace Ops for bespoke cases.
Risk: SLA misses during pilot due to staffing. Mitigation: allocate a rotating triage engineer from RevOps for the pilot window and monitor metrics daily.
Risk: Legal escalations slow throughput. Mitigation: add an ingestion field that flags contract bespoke clauses to fast-track to Legal with prefilled context.
